notes: M1.3 proof. The recognisable Grieg theme remains isolated on its source-derived track. ViceBlood adds a 138 BPM late-1990s big-beat sketch with programmed drums, distorted bass, industrial hits, low-string pulse and riser guide. The canonical repository source is a deterministic MIDI recipe; no commercial break recording or third-party audio is embedded or required.
